# Entlite documentation

Entlite turns one Go struct into a sql schema, typed database code, a proto
contract and a connect service. The schema is the single source of truth.

New here? Start with [getting started](guide/01-getting-started.md).

## How these pages are kept

The guide is hand written. The reference and the example pages are generated
from the source by `make docs`, and a test fails when they are out of date, so
they cannot drift from the code. Do not edit a file that starts with a
`Code generated` line, change the Go source instead.
